name: Agency Management System
description: An enhanced and optimized version of the Agency Management System with improved code quality, performance optimizations, and production-ready stability.
longDescription: Built for busy small business owners, this system provides a secure, offline-first environment to manage inventory, creditors, and expenses. It features a high-performance SQLite database, real-time sales visualization using Recharts, and professional PDF statement generation. v1.1.0 brings major improvements in code quality, component architecture, analytics, and UI/UX.

changes: Code Quality: Fixed ESLint warnings, React hooks optimization
Analytics: Enhanced debt aging, regional efficiency tracking
UI/UX: Improved responsive design, chart tooltips, accessibility
Production: 1.5MB optimized build, Electron cross-platform ready
